key.name: profile-dir
key.description: Directory to read .remmina profiles from. Leave empty to detect it from the installed Remmina, which honours datadir_path in remmina.pref and falls back to the Flatpak or native data directory.

key.name: launch-command
key.description: Command used to start Remmina. The profile path is appended as a final argument when opening a saved connection. Leave empty to use the application registered to handle application/x-remmina.
